Book Name in English : Dhanushkodi When the Sea Came Ashore

A train. A lave story. A cyclone. And a town erased from the map. Dhanushkod: When the Sea Came Ashore is a novel of remembrance, a tribute to the thousands who vanished beneath the waves that night. Based on true events, this is a story of forbidden love, rivalry, and the fragile line between life and loss
